system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: A TransformationDefiner agent receives three inputs: (1) a system prompt specifying the transformation-definition task, (2) the original training pairs, and (3) the compressed exploration summaries.
system_prompt_style.note: Orchestrator prompt code not in evidence; refinement adds an augmented prompt at start of context, which may make this dynamically_composed.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Training pairs are serialized into the prompt as ASCII grids with row and column coordinate headers (the same rendering used by CoT and pipeline/orchestrator agents)
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: the task grids and explorer summaries are injected up front, and the agent has no navigation tools. This is ARC, not a repository.

context_compaction.note: Explorer outputs are compressed to about 4k tokens each, but no history compaction of the orchestrator loop is shown.

observation_format.evidence_quote: all share the same ASCII grid format so the architectural lift isn't confounded by prompt format.
observation_format.note: Grids are presented as ASCII text, and train-feedback is returned as text messages.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: an augmented definer-as-orchestrator agent runs with five tools available throughout
tool_call_format.note: The parser mechanism is not shown; tool-call format is inferred.

tool_count.evidence_quote: an augmented definer-as-orchestrator agent runs with five tools available throughout
tool_count.note: The tools are think, define_transformation, submit_refined_transformation, explore_new_patterns and done. Explorers have 2 tools (think, note_pattern).

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: submit_refined_transformation(what_changed, code) : a structured output tool for refining a previous transformation, fitted with a field to describe the refinement and a field containing the actual refined Python transformation.
edit_primitive.note: The agent emits the full transform function each time; there are no file edits.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The orchestrator exits on one of three conditions: (1) a structural exit when train-set accuracy reaches 100% on a candidate program, (2) an agent-mediated done call, or (3) one of three fuses
loop_primitives.note: Multi_attempt: M=5 parallel definers with train-score selection. Phase 1 exploration precedes the loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: think(thought): private scratchpad, identical to the pipeline definer's.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: explore_new_patterns(guidance) : spawn K=2 focused PatternExplorer agents conditioned on a structured guidance string from the orchestrator.
multi_agent_topology.note: A Phase 1 explorer fleet (N=5) feeds the definers.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: explore_new_patterns(guidance) : spawn K=2 focused PatternExplorer agents conditioned on a structured guidance string from the orchestrator.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Their resulting pattern documents are appended to the context the orchestrator sees on subsequent steps.

long_term_memory.note: Runs are recorded in Postgres, but nothing is re-injected across runs.

self_verification.evidence_quote: Each candidate program is run on every training input and scored by exact-match accuracy on the corresponding training output

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The orchestrator's selection logic is identical to the pipeline's: orchestrator definers run in parallel, their candidates are dedup-ranked by training-set score
retry_policy.note: Parallel best-of-M rather than retries. In-loop refinement is capped by MAX_ITERATIONS=15.

rollback.evidence_quote: a structured output tool for refining a previous transformation
rollback.note: There is no filesystem state to revert.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: (1) a structural exit when train-set accuracy reaches 100% on a candidate program, (2) an agent-mediated done call, or (3) one of three fuses (MAX_ITERATIONS=15, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_EXEC_ERRORS=5, MAX_SPAWN_CALLS=3)
termination_condition.note: The consecutive-exec-error fuse is also a stop condition.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Explorers are given a generous per-agent token budget ( ∼100k tokens)

timeouts.evidence_quote: Definer-generated Python is executed in a restricted subprocess with a 10- second per-call timeout

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Definer-generated Python is executed in a restricted subprocess with a 10- second per-call timeout

network_policy.evidence_quote: a small allowed-import list (numpy, standard library), and no network access.

permission_model.evidence_quote: a small allowed-import list (numpy, standard library), and no network access.
permission_model.note: The import allowlist applies to generated code.

tracing.evidence_quote: All runs are recorded in a local Postgres database (source of truth); per-agent JSON is also written to disk.

guardrails.evidence_quote: a small allowed-import list (numpy, standard library), and no network access.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Scope:** ARC-AGI 1 (400-task evaluation split); extends to ARC-AGI 2 if successful.
target_domain.note: Abstract reasoning puzzles solved via program synthesis.
